name: 84104 · Salt Lake Cty, UT
findings: ZIP 84104 (Salt Lake Cty) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84104 (Salt Lake Cty) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84104 (Salt Lake Cty) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
